selected_problem: Fresh main still used default-locale String.localeCompare in semantic graph rank tie-breakers and semantic neighborhood tie-breakers. Equal-scored files could therefore reorder across host locales and change bounded semantic context selection.
route_basis: After workspace and repository-context ordering were made host-locale independent, the same directly reproducible bias remained in semantic ranking. Closing it preserves the existing scoring and neighborhood architecture rather than choosing a new semantic model.
change: Replace default-locale semantic path tie-breakers with deterministic code-unit lexical comparison.
truth_boundary: This closes host-locale dependence in the existing semantic graph ranking and neighborhood tie-breakers. It does not claim parser-grade module resolution, exhaustive repository observation, optimal semantic scoring, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
